comparison.objective: Both establish a machine setting and secure it, but the candidate sets an angular opening stop while this record positions a cylinder slot sensor at its switching-band midpoint.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires simultaneous concentric driver and wrench action with countertorque against jam-nut reaction; the record drags and clamps one sensor through a single seated hex driver using LED feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° stop retained over three close-open cycles; the record requires sensor position within tolerance, clamp resistance, and correct LED switching when the cylinder moves.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record, but it does not test the candidate's defining coupled screw/jam-nut counterholding ability; its setting is translational and feedback-located through one tool.
